Command.Name: SetWiFi_NetworkName
Command.FPOperation: Program device's TCP WiFi network name where it will be connected. To apply use -SaveNetworkSettings()

Arg.Name: WiFiNameLength
Arg.Desc: Up to 3 symbols for the WiFi network name len

Arg.Name: WiFiNetworkName
Arg.Desc: Up to 100 symbols for the device's WiFi ssid network name
